_meta.title: Working analysis: Senior-care walk-in tubs LP at 21% baseline
_meta.why_strong_example: Demonstrates preservation thinking on a high-converting page: identifies that the trust anatomy (BBB + license # + 'since 2007' + real installer photo + phone above fold) is doing ~55% of conversion load and warns aggressively against any test that touches it.

trust_anatomy.why_working: Senior audience defaults to phone confidence; visible click-to-call removes a step
Cold-traffic audience needs immediate institutional trust; BBB is the universal senior-recognized signal
Specific number + specific geography + longevity. Three multipliers in one line.
Overcomes the senior-services-call-center objection that's been burned into this audience

trust_anatomy.element: Real installer photo with name + 'licensed FL contractor #...' caption
trust_anatomy.why_working: Personal connection + regulatory credibility in single element

preservation_zones.reason: 18% load share; senior audience phone-first preference; mobile click-to-call removes a step
Combined ~25% load share; cold-traffic regulated industry
10% load; specificity premium ('4,500 Florida seniors since 2007')
Operator's lead-quality is reportedly high; form is filtering not just collecting

change_safe_zones.reason: Below-headline copy can be tested; less load-bearing than headline + trust stack
Reordering is a safe test; total content unchanged
Non-hero imagery is decorative not load-bearing
Below the line; minor conversion contribution
Specific value-prop copy works; minor variations test-safe (e.g. 'Get My Free Assessment' vs 'See If We Serve Your Area')

warnings_for_downstream: DO NOT propose hero_headline rewrite. Hero matches awareness-stage + audience identity. Estimated load: ~20-25%.
DO NOT propose form-field reduction without lead-quality evidence. Operator runs 4 fields; reportedly filtering effectively.
DO NOT propose removing or hiding the phone number, even for 'cleaner mobile'. 18% trust-load on this audience.
DO NOT propose replacing real installer photos with stock or illustration. 5% load + audience trust signal.
Tests that ADD trust mechanisms (more case-study-style testimonials, more press logos) are LOWER risk than tests that remove existing ones.
Mobile baseline conversion is unknown — operator should provide viewport-specific data for higher-confidence preservation analysis.
